properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-25, choosing options a and b of fact:root-cause-a-relation-with-no-typed-tool-cannot-be-found-by-find-tools-2026-10-25, in his words: "a. find_tools also searches relation types and answers \"use create_edge with INTERACTS_WITH\". Adds no tools. b. find_tools' reply points to describe_schema with from/to for \"what joins X to Y?\"". Not chosen: c, a typed interacts_with tool, which would add a tool and fix only this one relation. So: (a) find_tools ranks each schema edge type (its name, its endpoints and its reading) beside the tools, and a relation hit names the call that draws it (create_edge with that edge_type, or the typed tool where one exists) and the types it may join. (b) every find_tools reply says that "what joins an X to a Y?" is answered by describe_schema with from and to. The find_tools query corpus gains relation questions in a person's words (Alex's six among them), so the class cannot slip past it again. The tool count does not change.
